name: Roland XV-2020
description: Roland XV-2020 synthesizer module: the setup and system blocks, the temporary performance (common, effects, MIDI, and the Part block of each of its 16 parts), and Part 1's temporary patch and rhythm set, from the MIDI Implementation chapter of the owner's manual.

sources.title: XV-2020 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, June 4, 2002)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from XV-2020_OM.pdf (sha256 ce28b5feb6c1e586825f62eff3be5ae2475aaa8ba021cdf7b920472484181f4b). Model ID 00 10, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Performance parts are filed as "Part n" (id part<n>.*), Part 1's patch as "Part 1 · Patch · …" (part1.patch.*) and its rhythm set as "Part 1 · Rhythm Set · …" (part1.rhythm.*); the performance's own blocks as "Performance · …" and its MIDI blocks by channel.

LFO1 Wave Form and LFO2 Wave Form (0-10) print their labels as "SIN, TRI, SAW-UP, SAW-DW, SQR, RND, BEND-UP, BEND-DW, TRP, S&H" with "CHS" alone on the next line and no comma before it (the XV-5080's p297; every XV manual sets it so): ten labels for eleven values, so both stay numbers with the manual's line as their description rather than labels that would be off by one.
Rows the manual tags for other models (`<XV-5080>`, `<XV-3080/5080>`, the XV-2020's `<*>`) keep the tag in their name and choice labels, where a reader sees it, and lose it in their ids.

The manual ends each offset-table entry with a reference mark (`Rhythm Tone (Key # 21) *1-3-2-5`), which the reader keeps in the name and which stops it filling in the ":" run after a marked entry; the map then addresses only the entries the manual prints. Left out for that reason, with their addresses: Performance MIDI channels 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 12 00 and 15 at 10 00 1E 00; Performance Parts 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 20 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 22 00 and 15 at 10 00 2E 00; Part 1 Rhythm Set keys 35-81: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 10 10 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 02 00, so 35 is at 11 10 2C 00 and 81 at 11 11 08 00.
Identity: family code 10 01 and family number 00 03 (p146), its own among the XV series as printed: the XV-5080, XV-3080 and XV-88 print 00 00, the XV-5050 02 02.

Rows the manual marks <*>, ignored when received (p146), are the XV-5080's that the XV-2020 lacks (Mix/Parallel, MFX Control MIDI1/2, Voice Reserve 17-32, MFXB and MFXC Source, Receive MIDI1/2, Patch Common Tone Type, and One Shot Mode in Patch and Rhythm Common); they are not laid out. Choice labels the manual tags <*> (outputs B-D and 3-8, MFXB and MFXC) are kept as printed.
Each part's scale tune is in its Performance Part block (Part Scale Tune for C … B, 00 25-00 30), and the patch-mode one in System Common (Patch Scale Tune for C … B); there is no System Part block.

Presets list Patches (Bank Select MSB 87: User 00, PST-A to PST-D 64-67) and Rhythm Sets (MSB 86: User 00, PST-A/PST-B 64/65), p40-41, recalled on the profile's channel. Not listed: Performances (MSB 85: User 00, PST-A/PST-B 64/65, p41), the General MIDI 2 sounds (MSB 121/120) and the SRX boards (MSB 92/93).

Preset Rhythm sets: the MIDI Implementation's Bank Select table (p136) prints Preset Rhythm A and B with PROGRAM NUMBER 001-002 and NUMBER 001-004; the Bank Select table on p41 gives 001-004 for both and the specifications (p162) count 8 (4 x 2 banks). Four each are listed.

p159, <Example3> (an RQ1 for the Temporary Performance) calls the 00 00 00 31 size "the data size of Performance Controller" (it is the Performance Part's) and prints its result as F0 41 10 6A 11 10 00 00 00 00 00 2F 31 10 F7, with 6A where the model ID 00 10 belongs. It is not checked.
Chorus Type prints OFF, CHORUS and Reverb Type OFF, REVERB (p148): the XV-2020 has one of each.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.patch, part1.patch.mfx, part1.patch.chorus, part1.patch.reverb, part1.patch.tmt, part1.patch.tone1, part1.patch.tone2, part1.patch.tone3, part1.patch.tone4, part1.rhythm, part1.rhythm.mfx, part1.rhythm.chorus, part1.rhythm.reverb.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the instrument receives and transmits as Control Change (received p136-139, transmitted p144-145) is not mapped yet
coverage.parts: the Temporary Performance's Part block for every part the map addresses (of 1-16); the temporary patch and rhythm set of Part 1 only. Parts 2-16's are not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Performance Mode Part n) is at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 20 00 00 (… 14 60 00 00 for Part 16), its patch at +00 00 00 and its rhythm set at +10 00 00, the same blocks as Part 1's
coverage.patchMode: not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Patch Mode), the patch or rhythm set played in Patch mode, at 1F 00 00 00 (patch) and 1F 10 00 00 (rhythm set): the same blocks as Part 1's at another base
coverage.toneTypes: Part 1 plays a patch or a rhythm set; both are laid out (patch at 11 00 00 00, rhythm set at 11 10 00 00) and neither is read at startup, since a request the instrument cannot answer gets no reply and the engine's startup read stops at the first request that is not answered
coverage.rhythmKeys: rhythm tones for keys 35-81 (the General MIDI percussion keys) that the map addresses; Rhythm Tone (Key # k) is at the rhythm set's base + 00 10 00 + (k-21) x 00 02 00, so for Part 1 keys 21-34 are at 11 10 10 00-11 10 2A 00 and keys 82-108 at 11 11 0A 00-11 11 3E 00; all eighty-eight would be over twelve thousand parameters on their own
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.notModelled: User Performances (20 00 00 00), User Patches (30 00 00 00) and User Rhythm Sets (40 00 00 00): memories, not the edit buffer
coverage.notAddressedByTheMap: Performance MIDI channels 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 12 00 and 15 at 10 00 1E 00; Performance Parts 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 20 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 22 00 and 15 at 10 00 2E 00; Part 1 Rhythm Set keys 35-81: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 10 10 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 02 00, so 35 is at 11 10 2C 00 and 81 at 11 11 08 00
